duration: Confidentiality obligation of 4 years from the date of signing.

financial_value.payment_terms: Not applicable — non-monetary confidentiality agreement. A liquidated damages penalty applies in case of breach (see penalty_clauses).

termination_clauses: Terminates automatically upon expiry of the 4-year period.
penalty_clauses: Liquidated damages of EGP 200,000 payable in the event of a breach of confidentiality.
governing_law: Laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.
language_precedence_clause: In case of conflict, the Arabic version shall prevail.
